description.en:
Registers a character model as a speaker for the dialogue system, together with the name to show for it.
The name is given as a text key (for players, "pname_" followed by the character's base ID). The key is resolved to its localised text, and that text is stored with the model handle.

Up to 16 speakers can be registered at once. CMND_RESET_TALK_CHARA clears the list.
Handle of the character model that speaks.
Text key of the speaker's name, e.g. "pname_0035".

true once the speaker is registered.
false if 16 speakers are already registered.
null if the engine is not ready, fewer than 2 arguments were given, or the name key does not exist.
